# Set Airplane Mode

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the devices airplane mode.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setAirplaneMode(state: <#BoolNumb#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setAirplaneMode(state: true)
~~~~
